bonding-curve: Virtual curve before a DEX pool exists
direct-pool: Token and DEX pool created in the same tx
dominant: Majority of launches on its chain at time of writing
frontend: Branded frontend on a multi-tenant program
hook: Identified by a Uniswap V4 hook address
multi-tenant: One program serving many branded frontends (see builtOn)
native-quote: Buys use the chain's native coin
needs-abi: Launch ABI/IDL not decoded yet, PRs welcome
rotating-entrypoint: Entry contract changes; key on deployer or DEX events
scheduled-open: Trading opens at a published time
vanity-address: Token addresses end in a fixed suffix
